LESSON: SLOPES AS SIMPLE MACHINES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 3.3: Slopes as simple machines

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Slopes as simple machines. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How are slopes used in everyday life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify types of slopes used as simple machines
2. demonstrate how a slope makes work easier in day-to-day life
3. appreciate the use of slopes in everyday life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SLOPES AS SIMPLE MACHINES
This lesson teaches Slopes as simple machines for Grade 6 SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify types of slopes used as simple machines
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. demonstrate how a slope makes work easier in day-to-day life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the use of slopes in everyday life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Slopes as simple machines using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Slopes as simple machines above.
2. Explain Slopes as simple machines to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Slopes as simple machines.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Slopes as simple machines with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Slopes as simple machines important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are slopes used in everyday life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify types of slopes used as simple machines
2. demonstrate how a slope makes work easier in day-to-day life
3. appreciate the use of slopes in everyday life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
